Dr. Amara Osei · Lena Fischer · Tom Achterberg
Urban Heat & Green Roofs · City Research Lab

Half the roofs were planted with sedum or meadow mixes; half were conventional bitumen. Sensors at roof level and at street level (1.5 m) logged temperature every ten minutes from March 2026 to April 2027.
Green roofs ran up to 4.2 °C cooler

Three next steps for the city
Urban Heat & Green Roofs · City Research Lab
Target roofs above bus stops, schools and care homes first.
Extend the green roof grant to buildings over 400 m².
Keep 12 sensor sites running to track long-term effects.
